'''Naam&#39;s Huttese Theater''' was a theatrical venue located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Naam&#39;s Huttese Theater was created for [[Jeffery Carlisle]]'s [[Celebration VI]] artwork ''A Fan's Hope, Naam's Huttese Theater, Tatooine'', and included a number of visual [[Easter egg (virtual)|easter eggs]].
